scope: Eight fixed seeds, all18 new qualified plus legacy16 including15 qualified and one unresolved; Editor screening, no production acceptance
fullAndPhaseRule: Original gate success must not regress vs matched baseline; all per-seed/pooled results retained
noiseScreenLimit: Proxy screen only; original analytic/dynamic variance fixtures remain required
localHardRegressionRule: For every qualified point/channel (new18 plus legacy15), increase in absolute reference error beyond max(5e-6, reference*0.05, 2*combined empirical paired-seed/reference SE) is a hard regression. The legacy unresolved point is reported without a quality decision. Empirical SE is not a formal confidence interval.
disposition: Reject if no meaningful local benefit, raw mismatch, full/phase regression, noise screen failure or local hard regression. Do not scan2/4. If useful, seek broader qualification before production.
